If a registered route is already verified, reuse its sourced result rather than invoking Router again. Do not assume a universal Skill execution API. The host loads a Skill and executes its authorized work; the coordinator only returns decisions. Distinguish discovery, content loading, same-agent continuation, subagent scheduling, recovery and tool execution. Subagents are not implemented here. Without native continuation, return the smallest sufficient manual handoff and pending action; never claim automatic orchestration.

Using it still requires host capability and authorization; a Skill that forbids Shell cannot launch Node just to circumvent that restriction.
